synthesis.body: `pip-audit -r <requirements.txt>` (and npm/cargo equivalents) resolves every pin against the public registry, not the workspace. In a monorepo that both publishes a package and pins it from a consumer, raising the consumer's floor to the version this PR bumps to makes the SCA leg fail with 'Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement' until that version is actually published. It is a merge-ordering constraint, not a code defect, and it cannot be closed from inside the PR. Decide it up front: publish first, or land the pin in a follow-up and let the runtime feature-detect carry the floor. Do NOT carve the file out of the scanner — that removes coverage from exactly the dependency you just changed. Surfaced when credbroker 0.5.0's floor landed in the same PR as the bump.

title: An SCA gate resolves requirement pins against the public index, so a pin cannot lead its release
